name: Uptrace
description: Open-source APM combining distributed tracing, metrics, and logs backed by ClickHouse.

envVars.description: Password for the Uptrace PostgreSQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      UPTRACE_LISTEN_PG_ADDR: "{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432"
      UPTRACE_LISTEN_CH_ADDR: "{{serviceName}}-clickhouse:9000"
      UPTRACE_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.UPTRACE_DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/etc/uptrace
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: uptrace
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.UPTRACE_DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: uptrace
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:24.8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-clickhouse
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: uptrace
